notes:
Version 2.3.0.0 — Native browsing and timed games

Browse decks, players, and games with web-matching search, filters, statistics
periods, sorting, removable filter chips, and pagination. Browsing choices remain
separate from game setup.

Manage account preferences, passwords and sessions; upload or select player
pictures; edit admin identities; import decklist files; share or save exports;
and control strategy overrides with Auto, Yes and No.

Run chess clocks and turn timers in local and online table games, with increments,
modal pauses, low-time indication, restored state, and recorded timer metadata.
Companion devices display the host-controlled timer.

Requires the updated server for the new online features. Older servers report
feature-unavailable messages. Local games and pending offline records are preserved.
